## Summary

The team has made two retention decisions; the later one shortens log retention to 90 days (<mention-page url="https://www.notion.so/synthetic-workspace/Decision-log-retention-0000000000000000000000000000000b">Decision: log retention</mention-page>).

## Findings

- Customer exports are kept for one year, last confirmed in March (<mention-page url="https://www.notion.so/synthetic-workspace/Export-policy-0000000000000000000000000000000c">Export policy</mention-page>).
- General knowledge, not a team decision: retention periods are often set per data category.

## Open questions
